# uem_update_deployments (Data Source)

Enumerates update deployments in Workspace ONE UEM by walking every update in the catalog for the given organization group and flattening each update's deployments into a single list. Use this data source to look up deployment UUIDs and names for import. Note: resolving each deployment's owning organization group requires one additional GET per deployment (UpdatesV1Service.GetDeviceUpdateDeploymentDetails), on top of the one GET per catalog update already required to list its deployments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "organization_group_uuid" {
  type        = string
  description = "Organization group UUID to search for update deployments within"
}

data "uem_update_deployments" "example" {
  organization_group_uuid = var.organization_group_uuid
  platform                = "Apple"
}

output "example_deployment_uuids" {
  value = data.uem_update_deployments.example.update_deployments[*].uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_group_uuid` (String) Organization group UUID to search within (required)

### Optional

- `platform` (String) Filter catalog updates by platform (e.g. Apple, AppleOSX, AppleTV)
- `update_name` (String) Filter catalog updates by name

### Read-Only

- `update_deployments` (Attributes List) List of deployments across every matching update in the catalog (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--update_deployments))

<a id="nestedatt--update_deployments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `update_deployments`

Read-Only:

- `deployment_start_time` (String) Deployment start time
- `deployment_type` (String) Deployment type
- `name` (String) Deployment name
- `organization_group_uuid` (String) UUID of the organization group that OWNS this deployment, resolved via one additional per-deployment detail GET (UpdatesV1Service.GetDeviceUpdateDeploymentDetails).
- `ranking` (Number) Ranking of the deployment (1 is highest)
- `smart_group_count` (Number) Count of smart groups associated with the deployment
- `uuid` (String) Deployment UUID
